items.item: The hierarchy is an indented tree in which every unit with sub-units expands and collapses, exposed as role="tree"/"treeitem" with aria-expanded (or nested lists whose toggles are buttons with aria-expanded) and operable from the keyboard
items.evidence: treeContainer.innerHTML = `<div role="tree" ...>`; rowHtml sets role="treeitem" aria-level, aria-expanded="${isExpanded}" and aria-selected; toggleExpand() flips the expanded Set; keydown handler implements ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right, Home, End, Enter/Space navigation on .row elements.

items.item: Each unit shows its total headcount including sub-units alongside its direct staff (such as "42 · 8 direct"), and every parent's total equals its direct staff plus its children's totals
items.evidence: Row badge only renders node.headcount (a single number, e.g. '142'); computeHeadcount() sums only children's totals for parent nodes with no direct-staff concept at all ('node.headcount = node.children.reduce(...)'), so no unit ever shows a direct-vs-total breakdown like '42 · 8 direct'.

items.item: Each unit names its manager, and a unit without one shows "Vacant" rather than a blank
items.evidence: Every node in orgData has a manager object and the code unconditionally reads node.manager.name/title (e.g. 'Manager: ${escapeHtml(node.manager.name)}'); there is no null/undefined check or 'Vacant' fallback anywhere, so an unmanaged unit is not supported/handled.

items.item: The selected unit is marked in the tree (aria-selected or aria-current), and the details panel shows its name, code, path from the top (such as "Company › Finance › Accounts Payable"), manager and cost centre or location
items.evidence: aria-selected="${isSelected}" is set on rows and breadcrumbFor()/breadcrumbHtml render the ancestor chain (e.g. 'Nimbus Technologies Inc. / Engineering / Platform Engineering'), and the manager + Location dt/dd are shown — but no unit code/ID is ever displayed anywhere in detailPanel.innerHTML, only name/type/location/manager.

items.item: The details panel compares approved positions with filled ones and gives vacancies as approved minus filled
items.evidence: No 'approved' or 'filled' position fields exist in orgData, leafHeadcounts, or renderDetail(); only a single headcount number and a 'Showing X of Y' member count are shown — no vacancy/approved-vs-filled comparison anywhere.

items.item: The details panel lists the unit's direct employees with name and job title, and their number equals the unit's direct headcount
items.evidence: Code comment admits it: '// Explicit realistic headcounts for leaf units (roster above is a sample, not the full count)'; membersHtml renders only node.members (a short sample array, e.g. 4 people for eng-platform) while the badge/label explicitly reads 'Showing ${node.members.length} of ${node.headcount}' (e.g. 'Showing 4 of 38'), so the listed count never equals the unit's headcount.

items.item: Searching by unit or manager name expands the ancestors of each match and highlights it, and a search with no match says so
items.evidence: computeMatches()/renderTree() do auto-expand ancestors ('while (p) { expanded.add(p); p = parentById[p]; }') and show '#tree-empty' with 'No departments or teams match your search.' plus an aria-live status — but matched rows are rendered with the exact same classes/markup as any other row (no mark/highlight class or style is applied to the matching text or row), so matches are not visually highlighted.

items.item: Deactivating or moving a unit asks for confirmation in a dialog that names the unit and the number of employees and sub-units affected
items.evidence: No deactivate/move action, button, or dialog exists anywhere in the markup or script — the only interactions implemented are select, expand/collapse, and search.

items.item: A unit with no direct employees shows an explicit empty message in the details panel, and loading and error-with-retry states exist for both the tree and the panel
items.evidence: When node.members is empty/undefined, membersHtml stays '' and the 'Team roster' section is simply omitted (e.g. department nodes like Engineering show no roster and no empty-state message); there is also no loading skeleton or error/retry UI for #tree-container or #detail-panel — renderTree()/renderDetail() run synchronously against the hardcoded orgData with no async/error path.

notes: Mock data is entirely synchronous/hardcoded (orgData literal in <script>), so there is no loading or error state to exercise. Headcount totals are internally consistent (computeHeadcount sums children recursively) but the UI never exposes a direct-staff figure, so the '42 · 8 direct' requirement cannot be satisfied by the current data model. Audit flagged radius-scale (4 distinct radii incl. 12px rounded-xl cards) and uppercase-text (COMPANY/DEPARTMENT/TEAM badges) violations, consistent with the oversized-radius and tracked-uppercase-labels tells noted above.
